product: HP ZGX Fury AI station / NVIDIA GB300
benefits_are: Seller discovery interpretations of verified features, not measured customer outcomes or exclusive claims against competing hardware.

items.title: GB300 compute + large memory
items.feature: Up to 20 PFLOPS FP4; 748 GB coherent memory.
items.benefit: Fit larger models and richer context locally; validate precision and workload.

items.title: Rackable, liquid-cooled design
items.benefit: Place shared AI in a managed rack or near your team.

items.title: Shared AI for multiple users
items.feature: Concurrent users and AI workloads on one system.
items.benefit: Share one local investment across teams; validate workload concurrency.

items.title: Room to grow
items.feature: Link two systems; two 400 Gbps QSFP112 ports.
items.benefit: Add model capacity as needs grow; confirm supported networking and software.

items.benefit: Move models into local inference services and connect business applications.

items.benefit: Reduce initial setup work with a prepared AI development environment.

items.title: Dedicated management connectivity

items.title: Control data and capacity locally

items.benefit: Choose appropriate models and evolve workflows beyond a single model API.

qualifications: FP4 is HP’s published peak, not this demo’s measured performance. Model size, precision and concurrency affect results.
Dedicated 200–240V AC required. Validate rack, cooling, power and network requirements; options and storage must be configured when ordering.
ZTK client requires x86 Windows 11 or Ubuntu 24.04+ and VS Code; availability and model access vary.

RHEL certification is configuration-specific, not certification of this game or every AI workload. Subscriptions and support terms require confirmation; Red Hat AI Factory integration is described as planned in HP’s announcement.
